enchant_guidance.text:
Best in Slot Leg Armor for Protection Warrior in TBC Classic Phase 1
The Legs slot is not the most exciting one, as every option heavily focuses on mitigation, except the Arena Legs, which introduce a more balanced choice with a reasonable amount of threat but not nearly as good a trade-off as the helm, shoulders, or chest. Arena gear also poses the issue of using conflictual enchants between Tank and PvP optimization. If you prefer your Arena Legs enchanted with  for PvP, then they aren't a good option anymore, and you should stick to PvE drops.
